profile.headline: Expert Software Engineer (Data Engineering) @ Afiniti
profile.summary:
I replace fragile, manual data operations with automated systems that enterprise AI can depend on. 

For 9 years I’ve worked in the engine room of large-scale data platforms. That’s where Spark jobs slow to a crawl for no obvious reason and schema changes silently corrupt training datasets, and where a high-volume pipeline picks the worst possible moment to fail. Those are the problems I’m drawn to: finding the bottleneck nobody else could locate, getting rid of a class of production failures for good, keeping revenue-critical pipelines stable under pressure. I find that work satisfying, which probably says something about me. 

At Afiniti I’m the technical lead for the data pipeline service on Data Hub, a next-generation enterprise data platform that supports AI optimization systems across multiple products. I previously also ran the pipeline behind the AIRO AutoML platform. On both platforms I’ve owned the pipeline end to end: ingestion, PII classification, data quality, data modeling, transformation, and loading, plus every feature that ships through it, across multiple enterprise deployments in telecom, healthcare, and insurance.

Beyond the technical work, I drive feature delivery from start to finish, mentor junior engineers through the problems that used to stump me, and work with other service teams so dependencies don’t turn into blockers. Seeing the engineers around me get sharper is one of the parts of this job I care about most. 

Core stack: SQL, Python, Apache Spark, dbt, Apache Airflow, Greenplum, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, Docker, and AWS, with CI/CD built into how I ship. I’m currently expanding into GenAI application development and adding LLM and retrieval-augmented capabilities to data platforms. 

I’m open to mid-senior and senior data engineering roles where the work is technically demanding and the data matters. I want systems with real complexity, codebases worth understanding deeply, and a team that won’t compromise on engineering quality. 

If you’re building something hard, let’s connect.

projects.title: Text Mining
projects.description: Created ETL package using Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) to extract the text file data, transform and load it to SQL server. Data obtained from Integration Services was used for Data Mining such as cluster analysis algorithm using Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS).

projects.title: Airlines Data Visualization
projects.description: Analyzed raw airlines data to determine number of flights delayed or cancelled, number of total airports by state and other useful information. Downloaded and visualized data by using Python libraries like pandas, numpy and matplotlib.
